SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Kozhikode. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — to the Feroke tiles-and-timber belt, the Kallai trade area and construction sites across the city. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Supplier for Kozhikode Timber Units range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands — no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. In a trading and construction city like Kozhikode, that lets a timber yard, a merchant or a contractor add an admin office, a dispatch cabin or a site room without holding up the work.

Who buys a container office in Kozhikode

Kozhikode (Calicut) is a commercial and construction city with a strong timber and plywood trade. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Timber, plywood and tile units around Feroke needing an admin or dispatch office
  • Traders and merchants needing a compact office beside a yard or godown
  • Construction and infrastructure contractors needing a temporary site office
  • Plots and yards needing a gate and security office at the entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative, dispatch or site cabin — a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as process, sawmill-floor or hazardous-area structures.

Where we deliver in and around Kozhikode

We supply container offices across the main working pockets of Kozhikode:

  • Feroke and the tiles-and-timber belt — 673631
  • Kallai timber-and-trade area — 673003
  • Kozhikode city and construction sites — 673001
  • Ramanattukara and the NH66 junction side — served on enquiry

These belts run on timber, plywood, trade and construction — buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working yard or site. Because some Kozhikode plots have tight access, share your exact location and gate details, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Kozhikode site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point — a 10 ft cabin
  • An admin, dispatch or supervisor office — a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area — a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A yard or godown needing a compact office — a steel container office cabin for timber and trade units

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftAdmin, dispatch or supervisor officeMost common for yard and site use
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Kozhikode is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat and handle the Malabar coast's humid, wet climate
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your site works. Common additions for Kozhikode sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Kozhikode is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. The road route runs via Mysore and the Wayanad ghats into Kozhikode — roughly 350–390 km depending on your plot. Because the ghat roads and some city plots have access limits, we suggest planning 4–5 days after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the Malabar and coastal belt? See our Mangalore container office page, container offices we supply to Kochi, and container offices we route through Mysore.

Documentation for vendor onboarding

Traders and contractors in Kozhikode need clean paperwork for their own audits and site entry. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Kozhikode

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Kozhikode. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote — no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Kozhikode?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Kozhikode site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to Feroke and the Kozhikode timber belt?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory via Mysore and the Wayanad ghats to Feroke (673631), the Kallai trade area (673003) and Kozhikode city (673001) — about 350–390 km, so we suggest planning 4–5 days. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Which size suits a timber-yard or construction site office?

A 20 ft cabin covers most admin, dispatch and supervisor needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and e-way bill for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your container office in Kozhikode, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
